source: Belts are worn around your waist.

Rush toward a target enemy with incredible speed and perform a melee attack for 120%% weapon damage that can daze the target for 3 turns if it hits.
		You must rush from at least 2 tiles away.
target:
快速冲向敌人，并造成 120%% 基础武器伤害。如果此次攻击命中，那么目标会被眩晕 3 回合。
		你必须从至少 2 码以外开始冲锋。

deep_observation: 漏译+增译：源串 tome game/modules/tome/class/interface/TooltipsData.lua:419-422@624a67329fe2 的 "(global times movement)" 被并入「总体移动速度」，丢掉 global_speed×movement_speed 的算式（Actor.lua:2467-2468@624a67329fe2：value*util.bound(self.global_speed*self.movement_speed,0.3,1)）；末句源文仅 "This is applied after normal damage type resistances."，译文却增写「不受抗性穿透影响」，源串无此内容。
source:
#GOLD#Damage resistance: by speed#LAST#
All damage you receive, through any means, is decreased by this percentage, which increases as your total movement speed (global times movement) decreases.
This is applied after normal damage type resistances.
surface_observation: 原文明确说明总体移动速度为“global times movement”，译文遗漏该计算说明，并新增原文没有的“不受抗性穿透影响”。
target:
#GOLD#伤害抗性：速度#LAST#
所有类型任何方式对你造成的伤害按此值减免，随着你的总体移动速度减少而增加。
该效果在常规伤害抗性后生效，不受抗性穿透影响。

deep_observation: 过度改写：源串 tome game/modules/tome/data/talents/gifts/gifts.lua:23@624a67329fe2 是与同组 21-26 行（"Be at one with nature." 等）一致的无人称系别描述 "The way to combat magic, or even nullify it."；译文「你选择终生与魔法对抗并试图永远终结它」凭空加入「终生」「试图」，并把 nullify（使魔法失效）改为「永远终结」魔法。
source: The way to combat magic, or even nullify it.
surface_observation: 原文描述对抗乃至使魔法失效的方法，译文改成“你选择终生”对抗并“永远终结”魔法，新增终生承诺并改变了原意。
target: 你选择终生与魔法对抗并试图永远终结它。

source:
Call forth the Sun to summon a fiery beam that pierces to the farthest enemy dealing %d fire damage to all enemies hit.
		This spell will automatically cast again at the start of your next two turns.
		You will gain %0.2f positive energy each time firebeam or an instant damage proc caused by firebeam deals damage.
		The damage done will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
汲取太阳之力向目标射出一束太阳真火，射向最远的敌人，对这条直线上的所有敌人造成 %d 火焰伤害。
		此法术会在你接下来两个回合的开始时自动再次施放。
		每当火焰射线或由其触发的即时伤害效果造成伤害时，你获得 %0.2f 正能量。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

source: I can teach you staff combat (talent category Spell/Staff combat).  Learning the basics costs 100 gold, while more intensive tutelage to gain proficiency costs 500 gold.  Once you're proficient, I can teach you more refined techniques for an additional 750 gold.
target: 我可以传授你法杖格斗技巧（技能类别：法术/法杖格斗）。学习基础需要 100 金币，而获得熟练掌握的深入指导则需 500 金币。一旦你达到熟练，只需额外支付 750 金币，我便能传授你更精湛的技巧。

deep_observation: 机制错误：源串 tome game/modules/tome/data/talents/psionic/nightmare.lua:186@624a67329fe2 的 "Otherwise, if the summoning is resisted, the effect will end early" 以非睡眠为前提，译文「若目标豁免鉴定成功，则心魔的效果提前结束」丢掉该前提；timed_effects/mental.lua:1659-1663@624a67329fe2 的 on_timeout 为 `if self:attr("sleep") or self:checkHit(...) then ... else eff.dur = 0`，睡眠目标直接具象化、永不进入提前结束分支。同条内 manifest 还混用「具象化」「具现化」。
source:
Brings the target's inner demons to the surface.  Each turn, for %d turns, there's a %d%% chance that a demon will surface, requiring the target to make a Mental Save to keep it from manifesting.
		If the target is sleeping, the chance to save will be halved, and fear immunity will be ignored.  Otherwise, if the summoning is resisted, the effect will end early.
		The summon chance will scale with your Mindpower and the demon's life will scale with the target's rank.
		If a demon manifests the sheer terror will remove all sleep effects from the victim, but not the Inner Demons.
surface_observation: 原文用“Otherwise”限定只有目标未处于睡眠状态时，抵抗召唤才会使效果提前结束；译文“若目标豁免鉴定成功，则心魔的效果提前结束”遗漏了该分支条件。
target:
使目标的心魔具象化。在 %d 回合内，每回合有 %d%% 的几率会召唤一个心魔，需要目标进行一次精神豁免鉴定，失败则心魔具象化。
		如果目标处于睡眠状态，豁免概率减半，且无视目标的恐惧免疫。若目标豁免鉴定成功，则心魔的效果提前结束。
		受精神强度影响，召唤几率按比例加成。
		心魔的生命值受目标分级加成。
		心魔具现化时，会移除目标身上的所有睡眠类效果，本技能除外。

source: Some say that in their early days the Shaloren kings experimented with necromancy to preserve their flesh after death, but with little success. The Shaloren vehemently deny this.
target: 传说很早以前永恒精灵的王侯们利用死灵法术进行试验，试图让他们死后的肉体仍能永葆青春。不过他们并没有成功。但永恒精灵们都否认这个传说的真实性。

source:
Hits the target with your weapon, doing %d%% damage. If the attack hits, the target's armour and saves are reduced by %d for %d turns.
		Also if the target is protected by any temporary magical or psionic damage absorbing shields there is %d%% chance to shatter a random shield.
		Armor reduction chance increases with your Physical Power.
target:
用武器攻击目标，造成 %d%% 伤害。若攻击命中，目标的护甲和所有豁免降低 %d 点，持续 %d 回合。
		如果目标受到临时的魔法或灵能伤害吸收护盾保护，还有 %d%% 几率随机击碎其中一个护盾。
		护甲削减的成功几率受物理强度加成。

source: Yes, Tannen was not exactly friendly. I thank you for your help. Here are the components. [hand him the diamond and the athame]
target: 是的，泰恩确实不太友善。感谢你的帮助，这是传送门部件。[将钻石和仪式匕首交给他]

source: Lady Aeryn, at last I am back home! [tell her your story]
target: 艾琳女士，我终于回家了！[告诉她你的故事]

source: Open a hole in space, summoning an animated blade for 10 turns.
target: 在空间中打开一个孔洞，召唤一把活化之剑 10 回合。

deep_observation: 凭空添加地形：源串 tome game/modules/tome/data/zones/town-last-hope/grids.lua:50@624a67329fe2 为 "you set foot in sight of the Gates of Morning"（望见），译文作「到了晨曦之门的山脚下」；该 farportal 落点是世界地图（同文件 46-48 行 change_zone="wilderness"、spot=farportal-end/gates-of-morning），且晨曦之门是 "A massive hole in the Sunwall"（data/zones/wilderness/grids.lua:541-543@624a67329fe2），源文与源码均无山脚。
source: #VIOLET#You enter the swirling portal and in the blink of an eye you set foot in sight of the Gates of Morning, with no trace of the portal...
surface_observation: 原文“in sight of the Gates of Morning”说明落脚处能望见晨曦之门，译文“晨曦之门的山脚下”改变了位置描述，加入了原文没有的山脚信息。
target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼的功夫你已经到了晨曦之门的山脚下，此间毫无传送门的痕迹……

source: You must sustain the Jumpgate spell to be able to teleport.
target: 你必须激活 跃迁之门 才能传送。

deep_observation: 漏译+误译：源串 tome game/modules/tome/data/general/npcs/major-demon.lua:250@624a67329fe2 为 "A burning giant ... the power to crush and shape felsteel. Enter their range at your peril."；译文「锻造巨人的每只手都有一柄地底锻造巨锤」漏掉 burning（该 NPC 火抗 100、melee_project 火焰，同文件 268-270 行）与 crush（碾碎），并把修饰锤子的 forge 提前当作巨人名号；末句 range（攻击距离）误作「领地」，实体只有双持钉锤近战与火系远程天赋（265-266、282-283 行），无领地机制。
source: A burning giant wielding a forge hammer of the underworld in each hand -- weapons imbued by Urh'Rok himself with the power to crush and shape felsteel. Enter their range at your peril.
surface_observation: 原文“burning giant”的燃烧特征被译成“锻造巨人”；末句“Enter their range”承接前文武器，指进入其攻击范围，译成“进入他们的领地”改变了危险范围的含义。
target: 锻造巨人的每只手都有一柄地底锻造巨锤——被乌鲁洛克加持以锻造魔钢的巨锤。进入他们的领地是极度危险的事情。
一位饱经风霜的人类农民。

source: and raised as his tortured undead thrall
target: 并作为他的不死仆从永受折磨

deep_observation: 机制误译：源串 tome game/modules/tome/data/general/objects/world-artifacts.lua:677@624a67329fe2 的 "No rogue blades shall incapacitate the wearer" 指不会被夺去行动能力（同文件 691 行 special_desc「每 4 回合把流血、中毒或创伤转移给来源或邻近敌人」、697 行 wielder.ignore_direct_crits=30）；译文「盗贼之刃将不能加于装备者之身」改成刀刃无法命中/加身，该护甲并不阻止被击中，且 incapacitate 未译出。
source: No rogue blades shall incapacitate the wearer of this armour.
surface_observation: 原文“incapacitate”指使穿戴者丧失行动能力，译文“不能加于装备者之身”变成刀刃无法伤及穿戴者，扩大了原句的防护含义。
target: 盗贼之刃将不能加于装备者之身。

source:
Acid erupts all around your target, dealing %0.1f acid damage.
		The acid attack is extremely distracting, and may remove up to %d physical or mental temporary effects or mental sustains (depending on the Spell Save of the target).
		The damage and chance to remove effects will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
酸液在目标周围爆发，造成 %0.1f 点酸性伤害。
		酸液攻击极易分散注意力，可能移除至多 %d 个物理或精神临时效果，或精神持续技能；能否移除取决于目标的法术豁免。
		受法术强度影响，伤害和移除效果的几率会提高。

source: This unique-looking staff is carved with runes of destruction.
target: 这个品相独特的法杖上刻印着毁灭符文。

deep_observation: 漏译限定：源串 tome game/modules/tome/data/talents/techniques/archery.lua:705@624a67329fe2 的 "%d random techniques" 中 random 未译，Bullseye 的 proc 是 rng.tableRemove(tids) 从冷却中的 technique/ 系天赋随机抽取（同文件 673-693 行），译文「减少 %d 个战斗技巧系技能冷却时间」读作可自选；另 increased 漏译，「获得 %d%% 攻击速度」易被读作把攻速设为该值。
source: Each time you consume a mark, you gain %d%% increased attack speed for 2 turns and the cooldown of %d random techniques are reduced by %d turns.
surface_observation: 原文“%d random techniques”明确随机选择技能，译文漏掉“random”，未说明减少冷却时间的技能是随机选取的。
target: 每次消耗标记时，获得 %d%% 攻击速度 2 回合，并减少 %d 个战斗技巧系技能冷却时间 %d 回合。

source: Ungrol of Last Hope asked you to look for his wife's friend Celia, who has been reported missing. She frequently visits her late husband's mausoleum, in the graveyard near Last Hope.
target: 最后的希望城的温格洛请你寻找他妻子的朋友赛利亚；据说她失踪了。赛利亚常去最后的希望附近墓地中她亡夫的陵墓。

source: If enabled new quests and quests updates will display a big popup, if not a simple line of text will fly on the screen.#WHITE#
target: 如果开启，新任务和任务更新会以大弹窗显示；如果关闭，只会有一行文字在屏幕上飘过。#WHITE#

deep_observation: 漏译+残句：源串 tome game/modules/tome/data/general/npcs/horror-undead.lua:63@624a67329fe2 为 "putrid, torn flesh and chipped bone ... spurting blood and viscera along the way"，译文漏掉 chipped bone（碎骨），并把 rank 3、size_category 4 的巨型怪物（同文件 67-68 行）缩写为「这块……血肉」；末句「在路上喷出的血液和内脏。」缺谓语，原文为伴随状语。
source: This monstrous form of putrid, torn flesh and chipped bone drags its mass towards you, spurting blood and viscera along the way.
surface_observation: 原文描述该怪物由腐烂撕裂的血肉和碎骨组成，译文漏掉“chipped bone”（碎骨）。
target: 这块腐烂的被切碎的血肉，挣扎着向你移动，在路上喷出的血液和内脏。

deep_observation: 机制误译：源串 tome game/modules/tome/data/general/objects/world-artifacts.lua:7730@624a67329fe2 的 "fades over 10 turns if it is not fed" 是 10 回合内逐步衰减，译文「增益会在 10 回合后消退」读作满额维持 10 回合后一次性消失；同文件 7796-7813 行的 wielder 加成与 blood_dur 成正比（inc_stats=ceil(boost*dur/5) 等），7819-7820 行每回合 blood_dur-1、归零时 blood_charge 清零。
source: drain blood from all creatures within range 5, causing them to bleed for %0.2f physical damage over 4 turns (based on your Physicalpower). For each creature drained (up to 10), the armor gains strength, which fades over 10 turns if it is not fed
surface_observation: 原文“causing them to bleed”中的流血被漏译；“fades over 10 turns”被译成“10 回合后消退”，将消退过程表述为延后消退。
target: 吸收半径 5 内所有生物的血液，令其在 4 回合内受到 %0.2f 点物理伤害（基于你的物理强度）。每吸收一个生物（至多10个），护甲的属性便会增强；若不再喂食，增益会在 10 回合后消退。

source: Give them here. You took long enough; %s cooked up a %s in your absence. Be quicker about the next one lest I make a 'mistake' in brewing your reward.
target: 拿来吧。你可真够磨蹭的；趁你不在的时候，%s已经捣鼓出了一瓶%s。下一次手脚麻利点，免得我在酿造你的奖励时“不小心出错”。

source:
#GOLD#Damage resistance: absolute#LAST#
All damage you receive, through any means, is decreased by this percentage.
This is applied after normal damage resistance and is not affected by resistance penetration.
target:
#GOLD#伤害抗性：绝对#LAST#
所有类型任何方式对你造成的伤害按此值减免。
该效果在常规伤害抗性后生效，不受抗性穿透影响。

source:
You wake up after a few hours, surprised to be alive, but the staff is gone!
#VIOLET#Go at once to Last Hope to report those events!
target:
几个小时以后，你醒了过来，惊讶地发现自己还活着，不过法杖已经不见了！
#VIOLET#立刻返回最后的希望报告这件事！

source:
You fire a crippling shot, doing %d%% damage and reducing your target's speed by %d%% for 7 turns.
		The status power and status hit chance improve with your Accuracy.
target:
你射出一支致残箭，造成 %d%% 伤害，并使目标速度降低 %d%%，持续 7 回合。
		状态强度与状态命中几率均随命中提高。

source: A huge creature of the element Earth. Able to merge with its element, it has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.
target: 一只巨大的土元素。它有四只巨大的手臂，并且可以融合泥土。

source:
Your dirges deaden you to the outside world, reducing all incoming damage by %d.
The damage reduction will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
你的挽歌使你对外界变得迟钝，减免所有伤害 %d。
伤害减免受法术强度加成。

source: summon an elder vampire with Taunt to your side for 15 turns
target: 召唤一个会使用嘲讽的吸血鬼长老为你服务15回合。

source: I will see if I can find it.
target: 我看看能不能找到那个地方。

source: This jagged shape looks like a hole in space, yet it is solid, though light in weight.
target: 这个锯齿状的影像看上去像是时空中的黑洞，但它又是固态的，尽管重量非常的轻。

source: Play as your favorite race and class and venture into the infinite dungeon.
target: 选择你最喜欢的种族和职业，进入无尽地下城冒险。
